verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an llms.txt file at zoho.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), which an agent can be pointed at. The visible excerpt is a generic Zoho-suite overview rather than CRM-specific agent docs. Probes for markdown versions of the CRM docs and for an OpenAPI spec both returned 404. The MCP server documentation belongs to a separate story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: CRM-specific llms.txt content linking to the developer/API docs, machine-readable markdown docs, an OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration that agents can navigate the docs via llms.txt.
